name: Mapsurvey Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free AGPLv3 self-hosted geospatial surveys with 13 question types, map-based point/line/polygon responses, and GeoJSON/CSV exports; no software quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Requires own Docker/PostGIS infrastructure and operations; Mapbox basemaps may need an access token and incur charges. Managed mapsurvey.org cloud is a separate paid offering. AGPLv3 network-source obligations apply to modified deployments; project name/logo are not freely rebrandable.
